short.q: Write the German words with der, die or das for: cabbage or kale, toilet, fog.
short.answer: der Kohl, die Toilette, der Nebel.
short.working: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

short.q: Write the German words with der, die or das for: rice, breakfast, table, fridge, kitchen.
short.answer: der Reis, das Frühstück, der Tisch, der Kühlschrank, die Küche.
short.working: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (5 marks).

short.q: Write in German what you do on Saturday. Start with "Am Samstag".
short.answer: For example: Am Samstag spiele ich Fußball.
short.working: 1 mark for Am Samstag, 1 mark for a correct sentence.

short.q: Write the German words with der, die or das for: thunderstorm, candle.
short.answer: das Gewitter, die Kerze.
short.working: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

short.q: Write the German words with der, die or das for: garden, room, sun, thunderstorm.
short.answer: der Garten, das Zimmer, die Sonne, das Gewitter.
short.working: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (4 marks).

short.q: Write a short German dialogue of three lines in which two children greet each other, ask their names and answer.
short.answer: A: Hallo! Wie heißt du? B: Ich heiße Otieno. A: Ich heiße Amina.
short.working: 1 mark for the greeting, 1 mark for the question Wie heißt du?, 1 mark for the answer with Ich heiße.

short.q: Explain how to pronounce ß, sch and z, with one example each.
short.answer: ß is a strong ss (Fuß). sch is sh (Schulter). z is ts (Zahn).
short.working: 1 mark for each.

short.q: Write the German words with their articles for: kitchen, bedroom, garden, living room.
short.answer: die Küche, das Schlafzimmer, der Garten, das Wohnzimmer.
short.working: 1 mark for each correct noun with its article.

short.q: Explain how your voice should change for a question mark and for a full stop.
short.answer: It goes up at a question mark and down at a full stop.
short.working: 1 mark for each.

short.q: Read: "Im Wohnzimmer ist ein Sofa. In der Küche ist ein Kühlschrank." Say where each item is in English.
short.answer: The sofa is in the living room. The fridge is in the kitchen.
short.working: 1 mark for each correct place and 1 mark for the items.

short.q: Write the German words with der, die or das for: birthday, banana, tummy, apple, cheese.
short.answer: der Geburtstag, die Banane, der Bauch, der Apfel, der Käse.
short.working: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (5 marks).

short.q: Write these numbers in German: 1, 15, 20.
short.answer: eins, fünfzehn, zwanzig.
short.working: 1 mark for each correctly spelled number.

short.q: Write three sentences about the weather in German.
short.answer: For example: Heute ist es sonnig. Es ist warm. Der Wind weht.
short.working: 1 mark for each correct sentence.

short.q: Write the German names of these months: July, August, September.
short.answer: Juli, August, September.
short.working: 1 mark for each correctly spelled month with a capital letter.

short.q: Write the German words with der, die or das for: spoon, supper.
short.answer: der Löffel, das Abendessen.
short.working: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

short.q: Match the body part to what it does: Auge, Ohr, Nase.
short.answer: Auge = sehen, Ohr = hören, Nase = riechen.
short.working: 1 mark for each correct match.

short.q: Describe a floor plan of your dream house in German. Name at least three rooms.
short.answer: For example: Das ist die Küche. Das ist das Wohnzimmer. Das ist das Schlafzimmer.
short.working: 1 mark for each room correctly named.

short.q: Spell the name "Zawadi" using German letter names.
short.answer: Z (tset), A (ah), W (vay), A (ah), D (day), I (ee).
short.working: 3 marks if all letter names are correct; 2 marks for four or five; 1 mark for two or three.

short.q: Write the German words with der, die or das for: onion, parents, ear, cloud, cake.
short.answer: die Zwiebel, die Eltern, das Ohr, die Wolke, der Kuchen.
short.working: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (5 marks).

short.q: Write the German words with der, die or das for: bedroom, chair, window, watermelon.
short.answer: das Schlafzimmer, der Stuhl, das Fenster, die Wassermelone.
short.working: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (4 marks).

short.q: Write the German words with der, die or das for: leg, house.
short.answer: das Bein, das Haus.
short.working: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

short.q: Write the German words with der, die or das for: table, fridge, kitchen.
short.answer: der Tisch, der Kühlschrank, die Küche.
short.working: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

short.q: Write the German words with der, die or das for: cupboard or wardrobe, weather, back.
short.answer: der Schrank, das Wetter, der Rücken.
short.working: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

short.q: Read aloud and write the sound of these words: Schule, heute, Haus, Tür.
short.answer: Schule = SHOO-le, heute = HOY-te, Haus = house (ow), Tür = tür (ee with round lips).
short.working: 1 mark for each word.

short.q: Explain how to say the letters z, w and v in German words. Give one example each.
short.answer: z is ts (Zahl), w is v (Wasser), v is f in most words (Vater).
short.working: 1 mark for each correct sound and example.

short.q: Unscramble the letters KLAT and NEGER.
short.answer: kalt and Regen.
short.working: 1 mark for each; nouns with a capital letter, adjectives with a small letter.

short.q: Write the German for: I cook, I sleep, I read, I play.
short.answer: Ich koche, ich schlafe, ich lese, ich spiele.
short.working: 1 mark for each.

short.q: Explain why a menu uses a colon after the meal name.
short.answer: The colon announces the list of food that follows.
short.working: 1 mark for announces the list and 1 mark for an example.

short.q: Explain when to use "mein" and when to use "meine". Give one example of each.
short.answer: Use mein with der and das nouns (mein Vater) and meine with die nouns and plurals (meine Mutter).
short.working: 1 mark for each rule and 1 mark for correct examples.

short.q: Write the German words with der, die or das for: eye, neck, friend, uncle.
short.answer: das Auge, der Hals, der Freund, der Onkel.
short.working: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (4 marks).

short.q: You hear "Auf dem Mount Kenya ist es kalt. Dort schneit es manchmal." What is the gist?
short.answer: It is cold on Mount Kenya and sometimes it snows there.
short.working: 1 mark for cold, 1 mark for snow.

short.q: Write the German words with der, die or das for: orange, lunch, carrot, grandfather.
short.answer: die Orange, das Mittagessen, die Karotte, der Opa.
short.working: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (4 marks).

short.q: Write three sentences in German about your father or mother: name, age and one adjective.
short.answer: For example: Meine Mutter heißt Neema. Sie ist 35 Jahre alt. Sie ist nett.
short.working: 1 mark for each correct sentence.

short.q: Write the German for: sun, rain, wind, sky. Use der, die or das.
short.answer: die Sonne, der Regen, der Wind, der Himmel.
short.working: 1 mark for each.

short.q: Write the German words with der, die or das for: room, sun.
short.answer: das Zimmer, die Sonne.
short.working: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

short.q: Read: "Der Herd ist heiß. Das Messer ist scharf." Explain what the text warns about.
short.answer: The cooker is hot and the knife is sharp, so we must be careful in the kitchen.
short.working: 1 mark for each warning.

short.q: Write the German words with der, die or das for: foot, head.
short.answer: der Fuß, der Kopf.
short.working: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

short.q: Explain what reading in chunks means and why it helps.
short.answer: It means reading groups of words together, so your reading sounds smooth.
short.working: 1 mark for the meaning and 1 mark for the reason.

short.q: Give three German words or phrases for saying goodbye and say which is friendly and which is polite.
short.answer: Tschüss (friendly), Auf Wiedersehen (polite), Bis morgen (see you tomorrow).
short.working: 1 mark for each correct phrase; award the marks only if the friendly and polite ones are identified sensibly.

short.q: Write the German words with der, die or das for: bread, egg, tomato, water.
short.answer: das Brot, das Ei, die Tomate, das Wasser.
short.working: 1 mark for each.

short.q: Write two sentences about healthy food and one about unhealthy food in German.
short.answer: For example: Obst ist gesund. Wasser ist gesund. Limonade ist ungesund.
short.working: 1 mark for each correct sentence.

short.q: Write the German words with der, die or das for: finger, brothers and sisters, wind.
short.answer: der Finger, die Geschwister, der Wind.
short.working: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

short.q: Say why all nouns in a German text begin with capital letters and how this helps a reader.
short.answer: It is a spelling rule. Readers can spot the nouns quickly.
short.working: 1 mark for the rule and 1 mark for the help.

short.q: Write three sentences about your body in German.
short.answer: For example: Ich habe zwei Augen. Das ist meine Nase. Mit den Ohren höre ich.
short.working: 1 mark for each correct sentence.

short.q: Write three sentences about today's weather in German.
short.answer: For example: Heute ist es sonnig. Es ist warm. Der Wind weht.
short.working: 1 mark for each correct sentence.

short.q: Write the German words with der, die or das for: water, rice, breakfast.
short.answer: das Wasser, der Reis, das Frühstück.
short.working: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

short.q: Read: "Kamau hat Geburtstag. Er ist zehn Jahre alt." Say in English who has a birthday and how old he is.
short.answer: Kamau has a birthday and he is ten years old.
short.working: 1 mark for each fact.

short.q: Write the German words with der, die or das for: lunch, carrot.
short.answer: das Mittagessen, die Karotte.
short.working: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

short.q: Write the German words with der, die or das for: balloon, arm, sister, shoulder.
short.answer: der Luftballon, der Arm, die Schwester, die Schulter.
short.working: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (4 marks).

short.q: Write the German birthday wish "All the best for your birthday".
short.answer: Alles Gute zum Geburtstag!
short.working: 1 mark for the words and 1 mark for correct spelling and punctuation.

short.q: Explain what the colon, the question mark and the exclamation mark tell us when reading aloud.
short.answer: The colon announces a list or speech, the question mark tells us to raise the voice and the exclamation mark shows strong feeling.
short.working: 1 mark for each mark.

short.q: Write three German sentences describing a member of your family.
short.answer: For example: Meine Mutter heißt Neema. Sie ist jung. Sie ist lustig.
short.working: 1 mark for each correct sentence with capital letters and full stops.

short.q: Describe the structure of an Elfchen, line by line.
short.answer: Line 1: one word; line 2: two words; line 3: three words; line 4: four words; line 5: one word.
short.working: 1 mark for lines 1 and 2, 1 mark for lines 3 and 4, 1 mark for line 5 and the total of 11.

short.q: Write two sentences in German: one about a food you like to eat and one about a drink you like to drink.
short.answer: For example: Ich esse gern Mais. Ich trinke gern Tee.
short.working: 1 mark for each sentence and 1 mark for correct spelling.

short.q: Write the German words with der, die or das for: wall, tea, tooth, cocoa.
short.answer: die Wand, der Tee, der Zahn, der Kakao.
short.working: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (4 marks).

short.q: Explain why "Meine Mutter sind nett" is wrong and correct it.
short.answer: With one person we use ist. Correct: Meine Mutter ist nett.
short.working: 1 mark for the reason and 1 mark for the correction.

short.q: Write the German words with der, die or das for: knife, balloon.
short.answer: das Messer, der Luftballon.
short.working: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

short.q: Write the German words with der, die or das for: clock, leg, house, spoon.
short.answer: die Uhr, das Bein, das Haus, der Löffel.
short.working: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (4 marks).

short.q: Write your own Elfchen about a birthday. Check that it has 11 words.
short.answer: For example: Kuchen / Süße Kerzen / Wir singen zusammen / Ich bin heute zehn / Danke!
short.working: 1 mark for the 1-2-3-4-1 pattern, 1 mark for spelling, 1 mark for capital letters, 1 mark for meaning.

short.q: Explain the difference in sound between "ie" and "ei" and give one example day for each.
short.answer: ie sounds like ee (Dienstag); ei sounds like eye (Freitag).
short.working: 1 mark for each sound and 1 mark for correct examples.

short.q: Write a menu for one day in German with three meals.
short.answer: For example: Frühstück: Tee und Brot. Mittagessen: Reis und Bohnen. Abendessen: Ugali und Fisch.
short.working: 1 mark for each meal correctly written.

short.q: Name the three umlaut letters and the special letter ß.
short.answer: ä, ö, ü and ß (Eszett).
short.working: 1 mark for the three umlauts and 1 mark for ß.

short.q: Unscramble and write with der, die or das: NUMD and ESAN.
short.answer: der Mund and die Nase.
short.working: 1 mark for each word and 1 mark for each article.

short.q: Say what the tongue twister "Montags macht mir meine muntere Mutter mittags meistens Mus" means in English.
short.answer: On Mondays my lively mother usually makes me mush at midday.
short.working: 1 mark for Mondays and mother, 1 mark for the mush at midday.

short.q: Write the German words with der, die or das for: radio, nose, family.
short.answer: das Radio, die Nase, die Familie.
short.working: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

short.q: Name two ways to make the kitchen safer at home.
short.answer: Keep hot pots and matches away from small children; never leave the cooker alone.
short.working: 1 mark for each.

short.q: Write three words from a Kenyan greeting or from German that must begin with a capital letter, and say why.
short.answer: For example: Guten Morgen, Amina, Kenia. Nouns, names and the first word of a sentence begin with capitals.
short.working: 1 mark for examples, 1 mark for nouns, 1 mark for names.

short.q: Write the German sound for each letter group: ei and ie. Give an example word for each.
short.answer: ei sounds like eye (nein). ie sounds like ee (Tier).
short.working: 1 mark for each correct sound with an example.

short.q: Write the plural of Fuß, Zahn and Auge.
short.answer: die Füße, die Zähne, die Augen.
short.working: 1 mark for each correct plural.

short.q: Write the German words with der, die or das for: daughter, orange.
short.answer: die Tochter, die Orange.
short.working: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

short.q: Explain the difference between "Es regnet" and "Es ist regnerisch".
short.answer: Es regnet uses a verb and means it is raining. Es ist regnerisch uses an adjective and means it is rainy.
short.working: 1 mark for each meaning.

short.q: Explain why you should use reliable sources when you research a famous person's birthday.
short.answer: Some information is wrong; reliable sources have been checked.
short.working: 1 mark for each point.

short.q: Write the German words with der, die or das for: sugar, child, sofa.
short.answer: der Zucker, das Kind, das Sofa.
short.working: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

short.q: Write the German words with der or die for: father, mother, brother, sister.
short.answer: der Vater, die Mutter, der Bruder, die Schwester.
short.working: 1 mark for each noun with the correct article.

short.q: Write the German names of these months: January, February, March.
short.answer: Januar, Februar, März.
short.working: 1 mark for each correctly spelled month with a capital letter.

short.q: Write four short German sentences that a child could say about his or her birthday.
short.answer: For example: Ich bin heute zehn. Ich habe einen Kuchen. Meine Familie ist da. Alles Gute zum Geburtstag!
short.working: 1 mark for each correct sentence.

short.q: Write three sentences that say which item is in which room.
short.answer: For example: Das Bett ist im Schlafzimmer. Der Tisch ist in der Küche. Das Sofa ist im Wohnzimmer.
short.working: 1 mark for each correct sentence.

short.q: Write the German words with der, die or das for: cloud, cake, toe.
short.answer: die Wolke, der Kuchen, der Zeh.
short.working: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

short.q: Write the German words with der, die or das for: tea, tooth.
short.answer: der Tee, der Zahn.
short.working: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

short.q: Say why the word "Schlafzimmer" is a das word.
short.answer: Its last part, Zimmer, is a das word, and a joined word takes the article of the last part.
short.working: 1 mark for last part, 1 mark for Zimmer being das.

short.q: Write the numbers 3, 9 and 12 in German.
short.answer: drei, neun, zwölf.
short.working: 1 mark for each correctly spelled number.

short.q: Write the German words with der, die or das for: pot, face, father, grandmother.
short.answer: der Topf, das Gesicht, der Vater, die Oma.
short.working: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (4 marks).

short.q: Write the German words with der, die or das for: son, mouth, door, radio, nose.
short.answer: der Sohn, der Mund, die Tür, das Radio, die Nase.
short.working: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (5 marks).

short.q: Say the three time words heute, morgen and gestern in English and give one German sentence with one of them.
short.answer: heute = today, morgen = tomorrow, gestern = yesterday. For example: Heute ist Montag.
short.working: 1 mark for the three meanings, 1 mark for a correct sentence, 1 mark for capital letters.

short.q: Write these numbers in German: 3, 7, 11.
short.answer: drei, sieben, elf.
short.working: 1 mark for each correctly spelled number.

short.q: Write the forms of "sein" for ich, du and er.
short.answer: ich bin, du bist, er ist.
short.working: 1 mark for each correct form.

short.q: Write in German: "Who is that? That is my mother."
short.answer: Wer ist das? Das ist meine Mutter.
short.working: 1 mark for each sentence.

short.q: Explain when we use dem and when we use der after a position word like auf or neben.
short.answer: dem with der and das nouns (dem Tisch, dem Bett) and der with die nouns (der Tür).
short.working: 1 mark for dem with der nouns, 1 mark for dem with das nouns, 1 mark for der with die nouns.

short.q: Write the German words with der, die or das for: watermelon, pot.
short.answer: die Wassermelone, der Topf.
short.working: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).
